title: CFB Game Total — Native Website Routing Step 1
problem: The exact CFB -> Game Total Page-1 route still renders the legacy in-page 'Jump to a Sport Page' navigator even though KYRE SPORTS AI already owns site-wide navigation, making Game Total feel like a separate page instead of a native CFB website section.
root_cause: The current V38 Page-1 chain descends through V36 -> V35 -> V34 -> V33, and V33 injects the legacy sport/category jump shell before delegating to the frozen V28 Game Total body. The global KYRE universal shell already supplies site-level navigation, so V33 duplicates navigation inside the product page.
patch: Add additive Page V39 above V38. During the exact Page-1 render only, V39 temporarily redirects V33's render_game_total_hub seam to the frozen V28 content owner, then restores V33 in finally. The final Page-2 router temporarily points only the Page-1 cfb_router.GAME_TOTAL_PAGE at V39. Selected-event Page 2 keeps its existing Step-8 ownership unchanged.

tdd.red_result: Test-first contract was structurally unmet before implementation: additive V39 did not exist and the final router had no PAGE1_NATIVE_ROUTE or _render_native_page1 handoff. An initial V36 target was rejected by Step 2A after reconciling that V36 was already a frozen owner; the corrected V39 test-only head preceded all production implementation.
tdd.red_executor: Step2A repository-state proof; exact executable GREEN delegated to Runless CandidateWorkspace
tdd.ruling: V36/V37/V38 are pre-existing frozen Page-1 owners. V39 is the first free additive page owner and therefore the only legal target for this Step-1 patch.
